cmd:
echo "== unit deals-sync-trigger =="; systemctl cat deals-sync-trigger.service | head -14
echo "== скрипт тригера =="; ls -la /root/deals_sync_trigger.py 2>/dev/null || grep -rl 8788 /root/*.py 2>/dev/null
echo "== тіло тригера =="; F=$(grep -rl 8788 /root/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -1); sed -n 1,45p "$F"
echo "== unit nocodb-deals-sync =="; systemctl cat nocodb-deals-sync.service | grep -E 'ExecStart|OnCalendar'; systemctl cat nocodb-deals-sync.timer | grep OnCalendar
